question: What is the pettiest revenge you have ever taken on someone?
story: For two years, I secretly shrank my roommate's clothes, one wash at a time. This man never paid rent on time, ate my leftovers, and once used my toothbrush to clean his sneakers. So instead of confronting him like an adult, I chose psychological warfare. Every laundry day, I'd wash his shirts on the hottest setting. Just his. Slowly, everything got tighter. And here's the beautiful part. He didn't blame the clothes. He blamed himself. Bro joined a gym. Bro started running at five in the morning. Bro bought a juicer. He lost fifteen pounds chasing a body that was never the problem. At his birthday dinner he stood up and thanked me for being supportive during his fitness journey. I raised my glass and said nothing. He looks great now. Still hasn't paid me back though.
